content: Imezdaɣ n jdid n Urcalim u n tneddam iqqimen
Řḥukkam n řgens qqimen zeddɣen di Urcalim, umi řgens iqqimen igga taqedduḥt maḥend ijj zi ɛecra ad izdeɣ di Urcalim, tandint iqeddsen, u tesɛa di tneddam nneɣni.
Ibarek řgens marra iryazen nni iqeddmen ixef nsen s řxaḍar maḥend ad zedɣen di Urcalim.

Ina d izeǧifen n lɛamala, inni tuɣa izeddɣen di Urcalim. Tuɣa zeddɣen ayt n Israil, ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen d imsexxaren n Zzawect Tameqqrant d ayt n isemɣan n Suliman di tneddam n Yahuda, kuř ijj deg wagřa nnes, di tneddam nsen.
Di Urcalim tuɣa zeddɣen ca zeg ayt n Yahuda u zeg ayt n Binyamin. Zeg ayt n Yahuda: Ɛataya, mmis n Ɛuzziya, mmis n Zakariyya, mmis n Amarya, mmis n Cafaṭya, mmis n Mahalal-Il, zeg ayt n Fariṣ,
uřa d Maɛasiya, mmis n Barux, mmis n Kulḥuza, mmis n Ḥazaya, mmis n Ɛadaya, mmis n Yuyarib, mmis n Zakariyya, mmis n Uciluni.
Marra ayt n Fariṣ inni izeddɣen di Urcalim, aqa aten arebɛa-mya u-tmenya u-settin n iɛeskariyyen.
Ina d ayt n Binyamin: Sallu, mmis n Macullam, mmis n Yuɛid, mmis n Fadaya, mmis n Qulaya, mmis n Maɛasiya, mmis n Itiyil, mmis n Icaɛya
u awarni as Jabbay, Sallay: tesɛa-mya u-tmenya u-ɛicrin n yeryazen.
Tuɣa Yuwil, mmis n Zikri, d aweqqaf xasen u Yahuda, mmis n Hasnuwa tuɣa d ameḥḍay wiss tnayen x tendint.
Zeg ikehhanen: Yadaɛya, mmis n Yuyarib, Yakin,
Saraya, mmis n Ḥilqiya, mmis n Macullam, mmis n Ṣaduq, mmis n Marayut, mmis n Axiṭub, ameḥḍay n Taddart n AREBBI,
uca aytmatsen, inni ixeddmen di Taddart, marra idsen temn-mya u-tnayen u-ɛicrin n yeryazen. Xenni Ɛadaya, mmis n Yaruḥam, mmis n Falalya, mmis n Amṣi, mmis n Zakariyya, mmis n Facḥur, mmis n Malkiya,
d aytmas, izeǧifen n řaǧat, marra idsen mitayen u-tnayen u-rebɛin n yeryazen. Xenni Amcisay, mmis n Ɛazaryil, mmis n Axzay, mmis n Maclimut, mmis n Immir
d aytmatsen, ayt n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen, marra idsen mya u-tmenya u-ɛicrin n yeryazen. Tuɣa Zabdiyil, mmis n Hajdulim, d aweqqaf xasen.
Zeg Ilawiyyen: Camɛiya, mmis n Ḥaccub, mmis n Ɛazriqam, mmis n Ḥacabya, mmis n Bunni.
Cabbatay d Yuzabad, aqa nitni bedden ak-d řxedmet di barra n Taddart n AREBBI. Nitni zeg izeǧifen n Ilawiyyen.

Uca xenni Mattanya, mmis n Mixa, mmis n Zabdi, mmis n Asaf, azeǧif i yarezmen taẓaǧit s ict n tẓaǧit n uqadi, d Baqbuqya wenni tuɣa d wiss tnayen zeg aytmas, u Ɛabda, mmis n Cammuɛa, mmis n Jalal, mmis n Yadatun.
Marra Ilawiyyen i iǧan di tendint iqeddsen, marra idsen: mitayen u-arebɛa u-tmanin.
Iɛessasen n tewwura: Ɛaqqub, Ṭalmun ak-d aytmatsen, inni iṭṭfen aḥeṭṭu di tewwura n tendint, marra idsen mya u-tnayen u-sebɛin.
Inni iqqimen n ayt Israil, ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen, zedɣen di tneddam n Yahuda, kuř ijj di tesɣart nnes.
Imsexxaren n Zzawect Tameqqrant zedɣen di Ɛufil. Tuɣa Ṣiḥa d Jicfa x imsexxaren n Zzawect Tameqqrant.
Tuɣa Ɛuzzi, mmis n Bani, mmis n Ḥacabya, mmis n Mattanya, mmis n Mixa d aweqqaf n Ilawiyyen di Urcalim. Zeg ayt n Asaf tuɣa imedyazen x řxedmet di Taddart n AREBBI.
Maɣar tuɣa din xasen ict n tewṣeyyet n ujeǧid u x imedyazen tuɣa din ijj n weqqan, kuř ass ict n tewṣeyyet i ittřiqen i wass nni.
Tuɣa Faṭaḥya, mmis n Macizabyil, zeg ayt n Zaraḥ, mmis n Yahuda, d afus afusi n ujeǧid di marra min iřeqqfen řgens.

Di dcurat ɣar iyyaren nsen tuɣa din ca zeg ayt n Yahuda inni tuɣa izeddɣen di Qaryat-Arebɛa d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen u di Dibbun d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen u di Yaqabṣiyil d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen
u di Yecuɛa u di Mulada u di Bayt-Falaṭ
u di Haṣar-Cuɛal u di Bi’r-Sebɛa d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen,
u di Ṣiqlaɣ u di Makuna d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen
u di Ɛayn-Rimmun u di Ṣarɛa u di Yarmut,
Zanuḥa, Adullam d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen, Laxic d iyyaren nnes, Ɛaziqqa d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen. Nitni wtin iqiḍan nsen zi Bi’r-Sebɛa ař taɣzurt n Hinnum.
Tuɣa ayt n Binyamin zeddɣen zi Jabaɛ di Mixmas d Ɛaya d Bayt-Il d tneddam i ɣarsen dd-iqqnen,
Ɛanatut, Nub, Ɛananya,
Haṣur, Rama, Jittayim,
Ḥadid, Ṣabuɛim, Naballaṭ,
Lud d Unu d Teɣzurt n Teɣzurt n Iḥrayfiyyen.
Zeg Ilawiyyen zedɣen din terbiḥin zi Yahuda ɣar Binyamin.

footnotes.text: Aciluni- ijj n weryaz zi tendint n Cilu.
ict n tewṣeyyet- s Tiɛbranit ‘ijj n wawař’.
